name: bggg-skills
title_zh: BGGG 开源 Codex 技能合集，即取即用
tagline_zh: 不用再翻遍 GitHub 找技能。BGGG 把自家打磨过的 Codex 技能打包开源，装一个合集。
tagline_en: Stop hunting GitHub for skills. BGGG's open-source Codex skill pack gives you a drawer of vetted tools in one.
why_zh: 它是合集而非单点技能，一次安装覆盖多个场景；且来自 BGGG 实际项目沉淀，比零散搬运的 skill 。
why_en: A collection, not a single skill—one install covers multiple cases. Sourced from BGGG's real projects, it's closer to actual.
limit_zh: 仅收录 BGGG 自家开源技能，不保证覆盖你所有需求；部分技能依赖特定环境或 API key，装前需自查。
limit_en: Only BGGG's own open-source skills; not a universal set. Some need specific env or API keys. No custom support—beyond repo scope, you adapt it.
